hypotheses: EX527 inhibits SIRT1, increasing H3K27me1K36me3 and other repressive marks; donor BIX-01294 (G9a inhibitor) may share downstream histone changes but via H3K9me2 rather than H3K27me1K36me3.
EX527 may alter H3K27 methylation through SIRT1-dependent regulation of EZH2; donor CPI-169 (EZH2 inhibitor) would oppose this effect, so its response may be discordant.
EX527's effects on H3K27me1K36me3 could be mediated by metabolic changes; donor CHIR99021 (GSK3 inhibitor) may modulate similar pathways but with different histone outcomes.
EX527 may affect H3K27me1K36me3 via cell cycle arrest; donor Lapatinib (EGFR/HER2 inhibitor) could induce similar arrest but distinct histone modifications.
EX527's impact on H3K27me1K36me3 might involve BET bromodomain inhibition; donor GSK525762A (BET inhibitor) could produce overlapping but not identical histone changes.
object.evidence_gap: No donor with direct SIRT1 inhibition or known H3K27me1K36me3 modulation is available; donor pharmacology descriptions are needed to assess mechanistic overlap with EX527.
